'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Justin Carulli LS Yavin 4''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Justin Carulli]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Freedom to the Galaxy.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
